Updated short-range runs from regional meteorological centers show only minor day-to-day adjustments, reinforcing trader consensus around the 32–34 °C band ahead of tomorrow’s resolution.

eventMetadata.context_description: Forecast models from ECMWF, GFS, and AccuWeather converge on an afternoon maximum near 21–23°C in Moscow on August 21 under partly cloudy skies, light winds, and moderate Atlantic air masses that limit daytime heating. This stable late-summer pattern, with possible light showers or overcast conditions, aligns with historical August climatology of 20–22°C highs and explains the market’s 53% implied probability on 22°C alongside 26% on 23°C. Recent observations show no strong high-pressure ridge or southerly advection that could push readings higher, while any increase in cloud cover or northerly flow could cap maxima at or below 21°C. Updated ensemble runs through August 20 confirm limited variability ahead of official station resolution.
